source_review: Read the complete generated algebra and test-module patch. Only the private memo payload representation, its Pi replay constructor and explicit completed-result handling change.

The single Pi constructor produces the same power-1 rational-one monomial used before. Only immutable Constant(Pi) is tagged; other constants and composite Pi-valued expressions retain ordinary polynomial payloads.
Every post-budget path already yielded Some. unwrap_or_else retains the identical opaque fallback without adding a panic; early budget rejection still returns None before insertion.

The retained read, sharing/memo search, budget check/decrement, recursive operation order, Vec capacity and entry order are unchanged. Non-Pi cloning still precedes insertion and publication, and the first memo is dropped before an original retry.

Controls assert independent exact values, uncharged zero-budget replay, cold rejection, shared/sole transitions, all other constant categories, rational/empty forms, a Pi-valued composite, exhausted expansion and opaque owner reclamation.

Cache checks inspect the raw node local cell, allowing legitimate process-wide constant warming. Layouts are reported for both current and old payload/keyed-entry types; equality or savings are not assumed.

The full qualification inventories are frozen: 879 prior all-feature names plus three controls, and 791 prior default names plus the same three controls. The preserved prior default binary was enumerated only; its tests were not executed during preparation.
The V1 import failure remains frozen, with no V1 source or qualification outputs. The V2 Rust implementation and controls are byte-identical to the original draft.
Strict compilation, both full unit suites, layout measurements and costs remain separate pending gates.
